howToApply.title: The full application
howToApply.description: A step-by-step guide covering stages, documents, regulations, and admission deadlines.
howToApply.metaDescription: SIMU admissions stages, documents, conditions, international requirements, and deadlines.

steps.title: Application stages
steps.description: The process is sequential. Each stage has a clear outcome.

explore.title: Explore programs
explore.description: Review academic tracks, study duration, and admission requirements.

form.title: Application form
form.description: Download the relevant PDF form, complete it, and keep it for submission.

documents.title: Submit documents
documents.description: Prepare the required file and submit it to the admissions office in person or by email.

assessment.title: Assessment
assessment.description: Take the entrance exam or interview required for your chosen program.

results.title: Competitive results
results.description: Results are published on the stated date. Successful applicants receive an enrollment invitation.

enroll.title: Contract and enrollment
enroll.description: Sign the study contract, pay the first installment, and enroll for the academic year.

documents.title: Required documents
documents.description: Submit a complete file. A missing document may pause the review of your application.

application.title: Application form
application.description: A completed and signed form using the university’s approved PDF template.

identity.title: Proof of identity
identity.description: A copy of your passport or ID card, to be checked against the original when submitting in person.

diploma.title: Education certificate
diploma.description: Original and copy of the secondary or equivalent education certificate.

transcript.title: Transcript of records
transcript.description: An official record of final examinations or academic performance.

photos.title: Photographs
photos.description: Four color photos, 3×4 cm, on a white background.

medical.title: Medical certificate
medical.description: A health certificate in the required format.

military.title: Military registration
military.description: Required for male applicants who are citizens of Armenia, as provided by law.

conditions.title: Admission conditions
conditions.description: Admission is competitive and follows the university’s internal regulations.

education.title: Educational prerequisite
education.description: Secondary, vocational, or equivalent education matching the program’s entry requirements.

competition.title: Competitive selection
competition.description: Places are allocated based on exam or interview results and the submitted file.

language.title: Language of instruction
language.description: Programs are delivered in Armenian and/or English. Adequate language preparation is required.

contract.title: Contract and tuition
contract.description: Enrollment is valid only after the study contract is signed and the first payment is made.

capacity.title: Legal capacity
capacity.description: Applicants must have legal capacity or the consent of a lawful representative.

international.title: Requirements for international applicants
international.description: Foreign citizens follow the same stages, with additional legal and document requirements.

equivalence.title: Education equivalence
equivalence.description: The foreign education credential must be equivalent to Armenian secondary or the required level.

legalization.title: Apostille or legalization
legalization.description: The diploma and transcript must bear an apostille or be legalized as required.

translation.title: Notarized translation
translation.description: Documents are submitted with a notarized translation into Armenian or English.

passport.title: Passport
passport.description: A valid passport with at least 12 months remaining at the time of application.

insurance.title: Health insurance
insurance.description: Medical insurance or equivalent coverage for the duration of studies.

residence.title: Residence and visa
residence.description: After admission, the university issues an invitation to support residence status.

regulations.title: Applicable regulations
regulations.description: Admissions are governed by internal acts. The documents are available as PDFs.

admissions.title: Admissions procedure
admissions.description: Rules for receiving, assessing, and enrolling applicants.

tuition.title: Tuition payment rules
tuition.description: Annual fees, payment schedule, and late-payment terms.

internal.title: Internal academic rules
internal.description: Core provisions on studies, conduct, and student status.

deadlines.title: Application deadlines
deadlines.description: Calendar for the 2026–2027 academic year. Exact dates may be updated by official notice.

tuition.title: Tuition and
tuition.description: Annual fees for 2026–2027, payment conditions, schedule, and methods.
tuition.metaDescription: SIMU program tuition, annual fees, and payment terms.

programs.title: Tuition by academic program
programs.description: Amounts are in Armenian drams and cover one academic year or course. The contract confirms the official amount.

general-medicine.title: General medicine
general-medicine.description: A full medical program combining theoretical and clinical training.

dentistry.title: Dentistry
dentistry.description: Dental education with a modern clinical base.

cpd.title: Professional development
cpd.description: Continuing medical education courses for practicing specialists.

annual.title: Annual fee
annual.description: Tuition for core programs is calculated per academic year and may be paid in full or in installments.

installments.title: Installments
installments.description: Two equal installments are allowed according to the schedule in the contract.

enrollment.title: Enrollment condition
enrollment.description: A student is enrolled only after the first installment is paid and the contract is signed.

late.title: Late payment
late.description: Overdue payments are governed by the contract and may suspend academic services.

schedule.title: Payment schedule
schedule.description: Recommended two-installment calendar for the 2026–2027 academic year.

first.title: First installment — 50%
first.description: Paid when the contract is signed, before the academic year begins.

second.title: Second installment — 50%
second.description: Paid by 15 January 2027, before the second semester starts.

transfer.title: Bank transfer
transfer.description: Pay to the university account. Include the applicant’s name and program title.

cashier.title: University cashier
cashier.description: Pay in person at the university accounting office during working hours.

online.title: Online payment
online.description: An online payment system will be added later. Until then, use a transfer or the cashier.

apply.title: Download the application
apply.description: Forms are published as PDFs so applicants can review, download, and complete them accurately.
apply.metaDescription: SIMU application forms in PDF format for download and completion.

forms.title: Application forms in PDF
forms.description: Choose your application type, download the form, and submit it with your document file to the admissions office.

undergraduate.title: Undergraduate / medical programs
undergraduate.description: For applicants to general medicine and dentistry.

international.title: International applicant
international.description: Application form for foreign citizens, with additional fields.

cpd.title: Professional development
cpd.description: Application for continuing medical education courses.

submit.title: How to submit the completed form

inPerson.title: In person
inPerson.description: Bring the completed form and documents to the admissions office at the university address.

email.title: Email
email.description: Send a scanned PDF package to {email}, with the program name in the subject line.
